scope: one contiguous categorical motif of length 2–6 per snapshot, compared against all five exact baselines

checks.accounting: charge a three-bit family tag, length, motif definition, placement count and gaps, and raw residual symbols
checks.selection: enumerate every candidate in a bounded snapshot, use leftmost disjoint occurrences, and break equal candidate costs by first offset then shortest pattern; require strict gain against the complete baseline set
checks.controls: retain a negative periodic comparison and an absent dictionary; repeated separated motifs must recover exact placements and stream; relabeling preserves costs
checks.codec: decode exact selected candidate bytes; reject invalid layout, overlapping or out-of-range placements, truncation and budget violations
checks.install: run independent bitstring accounting, decoder checks and the full three-platform conformance matrix

limits: bounded in-sample sequence dictionary reference only. No held-out dictionary validation, relational motifs, statistical calibration or structural complexity score.
